component.name: Audiobook Reader
component.summary: Read, listen to and study your own book library — privately

description.p: A private, local-first reader over your own book library. Open any PDF, EPUB, Markdown or text file; read it on screen, have it read aloud in a neural voice, recognise text on scanned pages, and get AI study aids for textbooks.

Your books are read in place — never copied, never uploaded. Speech, text recognition and the local model all run on your own machine. A cloud AI provider is optional, never the default, and always tells you exactly what it is about to send before it sends it.

ul.li: PDF, EPUB, Markdown and plain text in one library
Document outline, in-book search, zoom and night mode
Reopens exactly where you left off
Bookmarks, coloured highlights and notes, exportable as Markdown
Neural text-to-speech that sounds like a person, not a robot
The sentence being spoken is highlighted, and the page follows along
Tap any sentence to start reading from exactly there
Adjustable speed and a choice of voices
Text recognition for scanned pages, so old scans can be read aloud too
Summary, learning, interview preparation, flashcards and key terms
Four answer lengths, from a single line to a detailed breakdown
Six AI providers, local first, with a built-in model installer that recommends a model your computer can actually run
